items.title: Collect F-009 and related Layer2 proof context
items.context: Use Lattice commands and existing decision docs to identify the exact suspected gap without touching .omx or treating stale artifacts as proof.
items.userSees: Context evidence lists F-009 text, suspected gap, source anchors, and related Layer2/Authority docs without using .omx.

happy.desc: F-009 finding text and related Layer2/Authority decision docs are cited in the execution plan.

edge.desc: The plan distinguishes suspected evidence from verified evidence and does not treat stale artifacts as proof.

adversarial.desc: No .omx path or legacy artifact root is used as source of truth.

verificationEvidence.note: The document cites F-009, its suspected status, and the current fact anchors used for execution.
The document separates suspected, verified, and disproven outcomes and requires mechanical evidence before status changes.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "disabled legacy artifact roots|clean artifact root|formal proof roots" docs/requirements/decisions/f009-layer2-engineering-proof-gap-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The execution plan requires clean formal roots and forbids disabled legacy artifact roots as proof roots.

items.title: Produce two host execution-plan drafts
items.context: Run Claude CLI and Codex CLI as independent read-only hosts. Each should propose a minimal executable plan for resolving or disproving F-009 under the four principles.
items.userSees: Two independent host drafts from Claude CLI and Codex CLI are available as input to the final document synthesis.

happy.desc: Claude CLI and Codex CLI each produce a bounded F-009 execution-plan draft.

edge.desc: The final document records host input without making either host an Authority.

adversarial.desc: Host suggestions that add arbitrary optimization or false capability claims are excluded.

verificationEvidence.note: Claude CLI produced a text-only A/B/C plan; Codex CLI produced a read-only phase/fail-closed plan. Both were consumed as drafting input, not authority proof.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Host Draft Inputs|Host output is review/drafting input only|Authority Server" docs/requirements/decisions/f009-layer2-engineering-proof-gap-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The host section records both host inputs while explicitly preventing either host from becoming Authority.
The document excludes arbitrary optimizations, false capability claims, and converting host transcripts into Authority receipt proof.

items.title: Write audited F-009 execution document and NAV entry
items.context: Synthesize only agreed correctness requirements into a decision doc under docs/requirements/decisions and update NAV count/link. Do not add capability claims.
items.userSees: A new decision document appears under docs/requirements/decisions and NAV links to it with the updated count.

happy.desc: The F-009 execution document is created and NAV count/link are updated.

edge.desc: The document states it is plan-only and cannot unlock Layer2 by itself.

adversarial.desc: The document does not broaden scope into Layer3/Layer4/global claims or production Authority implementation.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "41 个文件|F-009 Layer 2 Engineering Proof Gap Execution Plan" docs/requirements/NAV.md
verificationEvidence.note: The new F-009 decision document exists and NAV count/link were updated to include it.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "does not unlock|This document alone does" docs/requirements/decisions/f009-layer2-engineering-proof-gap-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The document explicitly states that it is plan-only and cannot unlock Layer2 by itself.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Do not unlock Loop Engineering|Layer 3|Layer 4|global Capability|Production Safety" docs/requirements/decisions/f009-layer2-engineering-proof-gap-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The plan keeps Layer3, Layer4, Production Safety, fullAuthorityDone, and global Capability Claim out of scope.

items.title: Audit the finished document
items.context: Final auditor checks executability, host-neutrality, non-authority boundary, fail-closed claim logic, and the four principles before DONE.
items.userSees: Final audit reports PASS for executability, host-neutrality, non-authority boundary, and logical consistency, or records blockers explicitly.

happy.desc: Final audit confirms the document gives an executable path to resolve or disprove F-009.

edge.desc: Audit checks consistency with existing Layer2 unlock, artifact isolation, lifecycle receipt, and Authority receipt docs.

adversarial.desc: Audit rejects false PASS language, missing fail-closed rules, and any local CLI Authority overclaim.

verificationEvidence.command: auditor rg checks over F-009 doc and NAV after commit
verificationEvidence.note: Final audit found a concrete phase plan, decision outcomes, fail-closed matrix, evidence pack, and DONE criteria for resolving/disproving F-009.
Audit confirmed the plan aligns with existing Layer2 unlock, artifact isolation, lifecycle receipt, and Authority receipt boundaries.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Forbidden fixes|Fail-Closed Tests|local diagnostic|Authority overclaim|This document alone" docs/requirements/decisions/f009-layer2-engineering-proof-gap-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Audit confirmed false PASS language, missing fail-closed rules, and local CLI Authority overclaim are explicitly blocked.
